units.source_text: 我写的那封信很长，母亲和我都以为先生这回肯定会回信的。

en.t: The letter I wrote was very long, and both my mother and I thought that this time Sensei would surely write back.

units.source_text: 果然，在信发出的第二天，我又收到一封电报，上面只有一句：“不来京也可以。”

en.t: Sure enough, on the second day after I sent the letter, I received another telegram, with only one sentence on it: "It is all right if you do not come to Tokyo."
I showed the telegram to my mother.
"Perhaps he means to write you a letter," she said.

units.source_text: 母亲似乎认定了先生会为我介绍工作，我也觉得有这个可能，但若从先生的平日为人来看，便觉得不对头了。

en.t: My mother seemed convinced that Sensei would introduce me to a job, and I too thought that might be possible, but when I considered Sensei's usual character, it did not seem right.

units.source_text: 在我看来，先生为我找工作是不可能的事。

en.t: To my mind, it was impossible that Sensei would find a job for me.

units.source_text: “我的信先生还没有接到，所以这封电报一定是在看到我的信之前打来的。”

en.t: "Sensei cannot have received my letter yet, so this telegram must have been sent before he saw it."

units.source_text: 我对母亲说了句不说也明白的话，母亲也煞有介事地想了想，回答：“大概吧。”

en.t: I said to my mother something that was obvious without being said, and she too thought it over with a serious air before answering, "I suppose so."

units.source_text: 尽管我明知用这句话来为先生辩解，是起不了任何作用的。

en.t: Even though I knew perfectly well that using those words to defend Sensei would serve no purpose at all.

units.source_text: 那天是主治医生请镇医院的院长一起来给父亲诊治之日，所以我和母亲没有时间多谈这件事。

en.t: That day was the day when the attending physician was to bring the director of the town hospital to examine my father, so my mother and I had no time to talk further about the matter.

units.source_text: 两位医生进行了会诊，又给病人做了灌肠等等处置后，就回去了。

en.t: The two doctors held a consultation, gave the patient an enema and other treatments, and then went home.
